fresh_generation.seed_derivation: For each named stream, derive the first 16 hexadecimal digits of SHA256(protocol_id|seed_root|partition|family_id|zero_based_index|stream_name), interpret as unsigned and reduce modulo 2^63-1. Use numpy.random.Generator(PCG64DXSM) only in the frozen environment.

checkpoint_registry_contract.failure_rule: Any missing, extra, renamed, reordered, mutable or byte-drifted registered input is a typed pre-result integrity failure and truth reveal count remains zero.

scientific_inheritance.rule: Every scientific field in the byte- and semantic-committed V2.4 amendment remains binding unless explicitly listed in change_scope.allowed. Omission never weakens inheritance.
